source.rationale: Third independent instance of the single-span completeness gap (Future Product Opportunities #11), reproducing the same SHAPE as the real case 001 and synthetic case 006 (a code example's call site AND a separate parameter bullet both need updating) in a third, unrelated domain (log rotation) specifically to test whether the pattern is domain-general or was coincidentally tied to the 'add one parameter, described in two places' shape common to 001/006's specific examples.

stale_doc_section:
```python
configure_logger("/var/log/app.log", level="DEBUG")
```

* `path` -- log file destination.
* `level` -- minimum log level to write. Defaults to `INFO`.
human_fixed_doc_section:
```python
configure_logger("/var/log/app.log", level="DEBUG", rotate_mb=100)
```

* `path` -- log file destination.
* `level` -- minimum log level to write. Defaults to `INFO`.
* `rotate_mb` -- rotate the log file once it exceeds this size in megabytes. Defaults to `None` (no rotation).

labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run). applied_old_text/proposed_new_text show only the parameter bullet was added; the code example (`configure_logger("/var/log/app.log", level="DEBUG")`) was left showing the old call, not updated to include rotate_mb=100. THIRD confirmed instance of the multi-span completeness gap (FPO #11), across three unrelated domains now (001 real/starlette, 006 backup/compress, this logger/rotate case) -- no longer just two similar-shaped anecdotes. Combined with case 016's rename-variant confirmation and case 025 below, this is now strong enough cross-domain, cross-change-type evidence to treat FPO #11 as a settled, real, recurring pattern rather than an open question -- recommend moving this from 'logged, not yet acted on' to an actual product decision on multi-span Corrector support.
